title: Global revision coverage and non-Docker GC acceptance
scope: Same-catalog SQL retirement and retention batches; file retirement with participating writers; explicitly enrolled independent file registry; bounded provider batch and coordinator process-exit recovery

boundaries.file_registry: single and atomic batch retirement under shared catalog flock; committed proof index and required anchor protect late admission; explicit retired-payload cleanup; old writers must be drained
boundaries.sql_registry: unscoped same-catalog SQLite/PostgreSQL; explicit single-revision retirement
boundaries.cache_batch: one exact private host file per apply
boundaries.revision_batch: preview limit1..128; SQL retention-apply validates exact preview and independently rechecks policy/references in one all-or-none transaction
boundaries.faults: libvirt/Firecracker coordinator process exits before effect, after effect, before report; missing/corrupt journal; cancellation, failed outcome persistence, queued-request journal loss; no automatic unknown resolution

not_closed: full API/Agent SIGKILL matrix and provider-internal partial calls
non-Docker unknown GC reservation reconciliation/release after explicit fencing
evidence_rule: all selected strict gates must pass on the same source digest and commit; failure/skip/missing environment does not close scope; original requirement remaining items stay open
